import string

lines_text = ['Sun, sun, and more sun!\n', 'The moon rises; the sun sets.\n']
out = open('story-l6.txt', 'w')
for item in lines_text:
    out.write(item)
out.close()

counts = dict()
fhand = open('story-l6.txt')
for line in fhand:
    line = line.translate(str.maketrans('', '', string.punctuation))
    line = line.lower()
    for word in line.split():
        counts[word] = counts.get(word, 0) + 1
fhand.close()
print('unique words: %d' % len(counts))
best = None
best_word = None
for word in counts:
    if best is None or counts[word] > best:
        best = counts[word]
        best_word = word
print('top word: %s (%d)' % (best_word, best))

name.ar: كلمة sun عُدّت أربع مرات بعد التنظيف
name.en: Word sun counted 4 times after cleaning

tests.code: assert 'unique words: 7' in __learner_output__, ('expected: unique words: 7 | actual: %r' % __learner_output__)
assert 'top word: sun (4)' in __learner_output__, ('expected: top word: sun (4) | actual: %r' % __learner_output__)
assert '2' in __learner_output__ and '1' in __learner_output__, ('expected: 2 then 1 | actual: %r' % __learner_output__)
